places.name: Nagoya Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic castle known for its golden shachihoko and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Honmaru Palace inside the castle grounds.

places.name: Atsuta Shrine
places.ai_summary: One of the most important Shinto shrines in Japan, housing the sacred Kusanagi sword.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning for a serene experience.

places.place_tip: Look out for the treasure hall showcasing ancient artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary for individual stores.
